title: Specmetry acceptance decision v1
description: Human-only decision on one acceptance criterion. Every field marked as seen is a read-time precondition re-checked atomically inside the write transaction; any mismatch is rejected with stale_precondition (exit 5 / HTTP 409) and nothing is written. Clients must never retry a rejected decision automatically: they re-read and require an explicit new human action. acknowledged_risks must equal the risk set the server derives for this decision (otherwise invalid_input).

snapshot.description: Seen: commit the delivery target resolved to. May be null only for waived.

requirement_revision.description: Seen: parent requirement's current revision. Must also equal the criterion's requirement_revision (parent applicability).

evidence_id.description: Seen: latest qualifying check run for this criterion on the snapshot, or null if none was shown.

seen_decision_id.description: Seen: the criterion's current decision (latest by seq for the current revision), as returned by the read model's current_decision_id. null only when no decision exists yet. Compared atomically with the latest decision in the write transaction; a decision made by another page or terminal in between yields stale_precondition.

mode.description: Required for accepted. normal: automated criterion with a passing qualifying run on the snapshot. manual: manual criterion, applies to this snapshot only. exception: automated criterion with no qualifying run on the snapshot; applies to this snapshot only and is flagged.

acknowledged_risks.description: Risks the human was shown and explicitly acknowledged. observed_evidence: the supporting run is observed-grade (only start/end states were checked). inconsistent_results: qualifying runs on this snapshot disagree. no_automated_evidence: exception acceptance without any qualifying run. Must be empty for rejected and waived.
